completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 2 条。

text.en:
Revised Edition of the Laws Act
(Chapter 275, Section 11(3))
Order under Section 11 (3)
O 23
G.N. No. S 586/2000
REVISED EDITION 2002
(31st January 2002)
[30th December 2000]
Whereas pursuant to section 10 of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act, the Law Revision Commissioners have published in loose-leaf form the Acts set out in the Schedule as in force on 1st December 2000:
And Whereas it is provided under section 11(3) of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act that the Commissioners shall transmit to the President a copy of each of the loose-leaf edition of these Acts and the President may thereupon, by order published in the Gazette, specify that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, in all courts and for all purposes, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts:
Now therefore it is hereby ordered by the President that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, with effect from 30th December 2000, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts.

THE SCHEDULE
1. Appraisers and House Agents Act (Chapter 16)
2. Building and Construction Authority Act (Chapter 30A)
3. Control of Plants Act (Chapter 57A)
4. Dentists Act (Chapter 76)
5. Endangered Species (Import and Export) Act (Chapter 92A)
6. Environmental Pollution Control Act (Chapter 94A)
7. Exchanges (Demutualisation and Merger) Act (Chapter 99B)
8. Extradition Act (Chapter 103)
9. Feeding Stuffs Act (Chapter 105)
10. Finance Companies Act (Chapter 108)
11. Fire Safety Act (Chapter 109A)
12. Info-communications Development Authority of Singapore Act (Chapter 137A)
13. Insurance Intermediaries Act (Chapter 142A)
14. Layout-Designs of Integrated Circuits Act (Chapter 159A)
15. Legal Profession Act (Chapter 161)
16. Motor Vehicles (Third-Party Risks and Compensation) Act (Chapter 189)
17. Multi-Level Marketing and Pyramid Selling (Prohibition) Act (Chapter 190)
18. Nurses and Midwives Act (Chapter 209)
19. Postal Services Act (Chapter 237A)
20. Prisons Act (Chapter 247)
21. Sewerage and Drainage Act (Chapter 293A)
22. Singapore Armed Forces Act (Chapter 295)
23. Stamp Duties Act (Chapter 312)
24. Telecommunications Act (Chapter 323)
25. Wholesome Meat and Fish Act (Chapter 349A)
26. Wild Animals and Birds Act (Chapter 351)
27. Sultan Hussain Ordinance (Chapter 382)
[G.N. No. S 586/2000]
